# Mahapatra Universal Limited

> Mahapatra Universal Limited is a diversified Indian conglomerate driving growth across infrastructure, energy, and industrial fabrication, with 12 business verticals. It builds the foundations of a stronger, more sustainable India.

Contact: contactus@mahapatrauniversal.com

## Company

- [Home](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/): Overview of the group and its core sectors.
- [About Us](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/about.html): Legacy, mission, and values.
- [Leadership](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/leadership.html): The leadership team steering the group's vision.

## Businesses

- [Our Businesses](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/business.html): Infrastructure development (road and urban development), energy solutions (including solar power), and industrial fabrication and manufacturing.

## Engage
